calculate_volume_ellipsoid: calculate the volume of an ellipsoid given three semi-axis radii r1, r2, and r3
run_f_gold: run the f_gold function to compute ellipsoid volume using the formula 4/3 pi r1 r2 r3
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against a set of parameter tuples with positive and negative radii
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function which approximates 4/3 as 1.33 for ellipsoid volume calculation
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to use the exact 4/3 fraction instead of the 1.33 approximation
